name: QR_Rule_03: User Added to Privileged Group
description: Detects a user being added to a privileged local, global, or universal Windows group.
gpo_policy: User and group management auditing must be enabled; privileged group changes must be reviewed.
expression: SELECT username, "TargetUserName", "TargetSid", "GroupName", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('4728','4732','4756') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: Event ID is any of 4728, 4732, or 4756. Optional filter: GroupName contains Administrators, Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, or another approved privileged group. Response: Dispatch New Event and create an Offense indexed by TargetUserName.
